title: Fallow Carnival — The Last Lights of the Midway
status: DRAFT creative authoring resources; no native simulation/editor acceptance

coordinate_contract.host_clearing: none; negative space assumes separately cleared host

style_guide.theme: Abandoned night fairground held in a frozen dry moment. Fun silhouettes read at 1x: gate, wheel, striped canopy, ticket booth, gallery, maze, game, pools.
style_guide.colors: Charcoal asphalt and iron, faded magenta/cyan/amber placards; bronze accents, small pale glass prizes. Neon IDs denote coloured materials, not guaranteed actual lighting.
style_guide.composition: Alternate vertical landmarks with low booths; do not place wheel and gateway side by side in dense regions without clearance. Leave >=22 cell horizontal gaps.
style_guide.no_functional_claims: No rotation, riding, reflection, scoring, working flood control, light or sound is implemented.
style_guide.source_boundary: Exact enumerated materials only. Combustible building panels excluded from fixed builds to avoid active kernels.
